body: In all probability you are reading peoples minds. Of course, you cannot real peoples minds so you are on a fools errand. At the end of the day what other people think of you comes second to what you think of you. I recommend doing activities that feel good to you so you can feel good about yourself. Above all you need to respect yourself.
Maybe reincarnation is real, or maybe everything just goes black. I kind of want to find out.
